notes.title: Ver16 - Small Fixes and Hints
notes.content:
Ver16 is live now, featuring a few small fixes:

 a fix for a bug where gem-porting out of the Clock puzzle with a plug lifted could wedge the puzzle
 a small hint for the final puzzle
 adjusted the solution to the Clock puzzle for less purple frustration
 slight change in the outro sequence


Thanks to everyone for the bug notes and suggestions.

(You can always spot the current version in the lower right of the credits screen.)
